beats.summary: Michael injures his foot by stepping on a George Foreman grill and struggles to get help.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I fell off the toilet. I'm caught between the toilet and the wall.

beats.summary: Dwight flirts awkwardly with Angela by calling her sweeter than candy and pats her on the rear.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Cause you're sweeter than candy.
Dwight pats Angela on the rear and runs away laughing

beats.summary: Michael holds a meeting about disabilities and shows pictures of disabled icons to the office.

evidence.snippet: Michael: While we are waiting for our special guest to arrive, I wanted you all to take a look at a few of the many, many disabled icons who have contributed so much to our society.

beats.summary: Michael insists on sitting in the front seat of the car despite having a concussion, invoking the rules of 'shotgun'.

evidence.snippet: Michael: The rules of shotgun are very simple and very clear.

beats.summary: Ryan helps Michael by bringing him chocolate pudding and aspirin mixed in it to ease his pain.

evidence.snippet: Ryan: I found the pudding cups you wanted in a gas station in Carbondale!
Ryan: I ground up four extra-strength aspirin and put them in Michael's pudding.

beats.summary: Dwight appears to have a concussion and is helped by Pam and Jim to stay awake and get to the hospital.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Uh, ok, I think we need to take him to the hospital because I'm pretty sure he has a concussion.
Pam: Dwight, here, let me help you Dwight.
Michael (sigh): I burned my foot!!! Ok, twenty minutes, conference room, everybody's in there!
Dwight: Cause you're sweeter than candy.
